continuity.arc_goal: Add complete linked workflow support to the Rust SDK with proper type separation, compile-time validation, and awaitable child results across contexts

progress_update.summary: We refined the linked workflows API significantly: added Invocation and Cancellation types with proper separation — Invocation (workflow path) has id(), cancel(), result::<T>() as DurableFuture; Cancellation (VO path) wraps Invocation, only exposes id() and cancel(). Added resolve() to InvocationHandle for resolving to Invocation. Made link() generic over T: From<Invocation> so VO paths return Cancellation and workflow paths return Invocation, all as DurableFuture. Fixed server-side JSON Result envelope for completion handler arguments. Added serde derives to TerminalError. Multiple code reviews addressed.
progress_update.goal: Complete linked workflow SDK with proper type separation between VO and workflow contexts
accomplished: Added Invocation type: id(), cancel(), result::<T>() as DurableFuture (selectable)
Added Cancellation type: wraps Invocation, narrows API to id() + cancel() only
VO start_linked() returns Cancellation, workflow start_linked() returns Invocation
link() generic over T: From<Invocation> — type inference selects return type
Added resolve(&self) to InvocationHandle — returns Invocation from any handle
Invocation no longer implements InvocationHandle (clean separation)
Renamed invocation_handle() → invocation() returning Invocation directly
DurableFuture + SealedDurableFuture impls for TrapFuture and Either
Server: JSON Result envelope with RawValue for completion handler args
SDK: serde derives on TerminalError, Result<T, TerminalError> delegates to serde_json
shared-core: LinkHandle type, sys_link returns LinkHandle
Exported Invocation and Cancellation in prelude
Two code reviews addressed all findings
progress_update.now: All types implemented and tested. Clean commit history ready for squash/PR.

decisions: Cancellation wraps Invocation via From, narrows API — no result() on VO path
link() is generic over T: From<Invocation> — call site determines return type
Invocation does NOT implement InvocationHandle — clean resolved/unresolved separation
invocation_handle() renamed to invocation(), returns Invocation directly
resolve() is &self not self — avoids consuming pinned futures
Result<T, TerminalError> serde delegates to serde_json (both sides)
Server encodes completion args as JSON Result envelope with RawValue
on_completion only via ObjectContextT path — no runtime panic risk
Handler input type: Result<T, TerminalError> where T: serde::Deserialize
T-suffix naming: ObjectContextT, RunRequestT, WorkflowClientT, RunT, CompletionHandlerFnT
sys_link returns LinkHandle (not SendHandle) with link_completion_handle
start_linked() returns DurableFuture for select! support
API: run_linked(req) on workflow client returns Request with linked:bool=true, .send() emits both OneWayCallCommand + CreateLinkCommand
API: unlink() on workflow client, fire-and-forget, emits RemoveLinkCommand
API: .send() returns impl InvocationHandle regardless of linked flag — CreateLink completion handled internally
